capabilities: search and open files with customizable ranking and preset search commands
grep note contents with ripgrep, sorted by modified time
search and navigate headers, links, and backlinks from within dialogs
preview notes without closing the dialog, with optional auto preview
move files between folders and batch-open or insert multi-selected results
extras: The author says they rarely use Obsidian anymore and will only fix reported security vulnerabilities; no new features or non-security bug fixes are planned. The public API for external scripts is labeled experimental and may change. Mobile support is not personally verified by the author.
intentEvidence: This is an Obsidian plugin which is another choice of Quick switcher.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Quick Switcher only does basic file-name lookup, without custom ranking, property/tag/header matching, content grep, or previewing without leaving the dialog.

relations.evidence: This feature requires ripgrep and set the executable command
allows external scripts (e.g., Templater) to programmatically open the file picker dialog

summary: Replacement quick switcher with custom search commands, ripgrep grep, backlink/link/header search, in-dialog preview, batch actions, and a command palette.
